notes.title: CAPS LOCK DAY bundle with 4 typing games for 40% off
notes.content:
Great news for all typing game enthusiasts out there: Typefighters is part of a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1809/]new bundle for celebrating CAPS LOCK DAY[/url], also including [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/398850/]Epistory[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/373970/]Letterquest[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/335790/]Words for Evil[/url]. With the bundle you get 40% off, excluding any games you might already own. So even if you are already a Typefighter, take a look at these other amazing games.

Happy typing!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/14168886/4038547c4276a6fe4f0f7f285f1cbb4b55e59daa.gif[/img]
